## Security, OCP & Verification Checklist

- [ ] **Open-Closed Principle (OCP):** No `if/elif/match` branches checking concrete detector, entity, or strategy types inside `src/pipeline/`.
- [ ] **Encapsulation:** `TokenVault` and `AnonymizationMemento` internals are never accessed directly outside `VaultProtectionProxy` / `Originator`.
- [ ] **Zero PII Leakage:** Exception messages, `AuditEvent` payloads, and `__repr__` / `__str__` redact raw PII/PHI values.
- [ ] **Verification Gates Passed:** `pytest -v`, `mypy --strict src/`, `ruff check src/ tests/`, `bandit -r src/`, and `pip-audit` all pass with zero errors.
